tickets.title: Prepare transfer instructions for charitable share donation
tickets.text: Prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of long-held Copper Firefly Utilities shares from Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk's $1.42 million joint taxable brokerage account to Nora's donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable. The shares carry substantial unrealized appreciation.
tickets.evidence: The agreed August 2 follow-up is to prepare transfer instructions for donating about $50,000 of Copper Firefly Utilities shares to Nora’s donor-advised fund at Velvet Acorn Charitable.

tickets.title: Obtain charitable status letter for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust
tickets.text: Obtain a current charitable status letter or receipt-language sample for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust for Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk, who prioritize medical research giving and averaged about $18,000 yearly giving over the prior three years.
tickets.evidence: Needed by August 9 are a current charitable status letter or receipt-language sample for Paper Otter Medical Research Trust

tickets.title: Resolve Marzipan Meadow Arts School/Foundation EIN mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the EIN payee mismatch between Marzipan Meadow Arts School and Marzipan Meadow Arts Foundation for Nora and Martin Nettlewhisk, who prioritize local arts education giving.
tickets.evidence: needed by August 5 is resolution of the Marzipan Meadow Arts School/Foundation EIN payee mismatch.
